Name: Kenneth's Vanilla Seeds Addon
Author: Kf29
Description:
[b]Kenneth's Vanilla Seeds Addon[/b]

[b]Never miss a planting season again! Get seeds, saplings, and tree seeds year-round in Kenneth's Seed Shop![/b]

[b]IMPORTANT - 2 VERSIONS AVAILABLE - CHOOSE ONE ONLY![/b]

[b]This mod page contains 2 versions. Do not install both at the same time. Pick the one you want:[/b]

[b]VERSION 1: Vanilla Edition (Pierre's Prices)[/b]
[b]🌱 100% Same price as Pierre! Vanilla accurate, all year available.[/b]
[b]- Parsnip 20g, Cauliflower 80g, etc. - Exactly Pierre's prices[/b]
[b]- Basic seasonal seeds & fruit saplings only (Parsnip, Potato, Melon, Tomato, Pumpkin, Cherry, Apple, etc.)[/b]
[b]- For players who want pure vanilla economy.[/b]

[b]VERSION 2: Complete Edition (Balanced Prices)[/b]
[b]🌱 Complete + Balanced! 2x price for balance, all year available.[/b]
[b]- Balanced x2 price (Parsnip 40g, Cauliflower 160g) because rare seeds are included. Fair price for rare items![/b]
[b]- Expensive because it includes seeds that are NOT normally buyable![/b]
[b]- 52 Items! Includes EVERYTHING:[/b]
[b]🌾 Crop Seeds: Parsnip, Green Bean, Cauliflower, Potato, Garlic, Rice, Melon, Tomato, Blueberry, Wheat, Corn, Eggplant, Pumpkin, Bok Choy, Yam, Beet, Rhubarb, Pineapple, Ancient Seeds, Strawberry, Coffee Bean, Poppy, Sunflower, Spice Berry, Amaranth, Cranberry, Taro, Cactus, Qi Bean & more![/b]
[b]🌸 Flower Seeds: Jazz, Tulip, Poppy, Fairy, Sunflower[/b]
[b]🌳 Saplings: Cherry, Apricot, Orange, Peach, Apple, Pomegranate, Banana 25k, Mango 25k, Tea Sapling[/b]
[b]🌲 Tree Seeds: Acorn, Maple, Pine, Mahogany, Mushroom Tree 25k, Mystic Tree[/b]
[b]🌿 Grass: Grass Starter & Blue Grass Starter 10k[/b]
[b]- For end-game / complete collection.[/b]

[b]FEATURES FOR BOTH VERSIONS:[/b]
[b]✅ New Configurable Shop Location - Shop1, Shop2, Shop3, Shop4, Shop5[/b]
[b]✅ Change via Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM) in-game[/b]
[b]✅ Default: Shop5 (Vanilla Edition) / Shop5 (Complete Edition)[/b]
[b]✅ Both available ALL YEAR - no seasonal waiting![/b]

[b]Perfect for:[/b]
[b]• Planting any crop any season[/b]
[b]• Getting rare saplings (Banana, Mango, Mushroom) without Island Trader[/b]
[b]• Year-round farming freedom[/b]

[b]Requirements:[/b]
[b]• Kenneth's Seed Shop (Required Main Mod)[/b]
[b]• Content Patcher[/b]
[b]• Stardew Valley 1.6.15+[/b]
[b]• (Optional) Generic Mod Config Menu for changing shop location[/b]

[b]Installation:[/b]
[b]1. Install Kenneth's Seed Shop[/b]
[b]2. Download ONE version from this page[/b]
[b]3. Extract to Mods folder[/b]
[b]4. Run with SMAPI[/b]

[b]Super Lightweight & Balanced - no new items, just vanilla seeds in Kenneth's Seed Shop![/b]
